skills_changed.change: fixed 10% → 25%–50% (scales with hero level); 2 Stacks (Zealous-Devastation): new effect can use while moving; 3 Stacks (Zenith-Wildfire): improved playability.

skills_changed.skill: Skill 2 - Cloudchaser | Charged Sweep Base Damage
skills_changed.change: 80 (+30/lvl) (+50% PATK) → 180 (+36/lvl) (+60% extra PATK); Fully Charged Sweep: 160 (+60/lvl) (+100% PATK) → 360 (+72/lvl) (+120% extra PATK).
40s (-2.5s/lvl) → 40s (-4/lvl); Damage Reduction: 10% (+30%/lvl) → 30% (+15%/lvl).

hero_adjustments.name: Arthur
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Health recovery and skill damage

hero_adjustments.name: Fatih
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased recovery capabilities and adjusted skill damage.

hero_adjustments.name: Kaizer
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased skill recovery and skill effect

hero_adjustments.name: Luara
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced Mana consumption and adjusted skill damage.

hero_adjustments.name: Cai Yan
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Skill 1 - Healing Hymn | Mana Cost: 80 → 75. Skill 2 - Earworm | Mana Cost: 60 → 50.

hero_adjustments.name: Garuda
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Skill 1 - Arrows of Gold | Mana Cost: 65 → 60.

skills_changed.skill: Skill 1 - Arrows of Gold | Mana Cost

hero_adjustments.name: Mozi
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Skill 2 - Cannon Blast | Mana Cost: 50 → 40.

hero_adjustments.name: Agudo
hero_adjustments.details_raw:
Mountain Encounter: Removed Health recovery from picking up Seed Mines and the slow on enemies that touch Seed Mines.
Wild Growth: Monsters no longer trigger on-hit effects.
Gorge Mobilization: Furball's triggered on-hit effect increased from 50% to 100%.

hero_adjustments.name: Agudo
hero_adjustments.details_raw:
Mountain Encounter: When Agudo is near a monster, Recovery is replaced with Release. Basic Attacks drop Seed Mines. Picking up a mine grants 3–6% Attack Speed and Movement Speed for 2.5 seconds, stacking up to 6 times; enemies touching a mine take 30–60 (+10% extra Physical Attack) physical damage.
Wild Growth: Creates an animal wonderland that grants Agudo and her summons 15% Attack Speed, scaling Movement Speed, and Health recovery. Animal companions scale with Agudo's level and inherit 50% of her Physical Attack, Attack Speed, Critical Rate, and part of her on-hit effect bonus.
Tumble, Furball!: While riding Furball, Agudo rolls forward, gains immunity to one hard crowd control, blocks damage, damages and stuns the first enemy hit, and can ricochet from walls up to three times.
Gorge Mobilization: Furball leaps to the target location, deals physical damage, stuns enemies, then fights independently with 50% of Agudo's stat buffs and on-hit effects. Furball can recover after death or be recalled early.

hero_adjustments.name: Yang Jian
hero_adjustments.summary: We've added a brand-new ability, the Heaven-Earth Form, enhancing Yang Jian's unique Resistance mechanic and visual appearance. We've also significantly optimized the hit mechanic for Heaven Hound, and added a new Heavenly Eye attack in the normal state, granting both recovery and true damage.

hero_adjustments.name: Nakoruru
hero_adjustments.summary: Ultimate Effect & Enhanced Basic Attack Upgrade
hero_adjustments.details_raw: We've improved how Nakoruru and Mamahaha interact and battle together. Mamahaha can now help Nakoruru to fly over walls and provide a Movement Speed boost when Nakoruru leaves combat. Additionally, Nakoruru's enhanced Basic Attacks now stack, allowing you to deal more damage. We've also improved Nakoruru's endurance.

hero_adjustments.name: Jing
hero_adjustments.summary: Enhanced Basic Attack and Ultimate Effect Upgrade

hero_adjustments.name: Xiang Yu
hero_adjustments.summary: Enhanced Basic Attack and Ultimate Effect Upgrade

hero_adjustments.name: Dian Wei
hero_adjustments.summary: Adjusted the early and late-game damage of enhanced Basic Attacks

hero_adjustments.name: Dun
hero_adjustments.summary: Adjusted the damage enhanced Basic Attacks deal to heroes and non-hero units

hero_adjustments.name: Sun Bin
hero_adjustments.summary: Skill 1 damage increased, Skill 2's cooldown reduced

hero_adjustments.name: Wang Zhaojun
hero_adjustments.summary: Skill 1 cooldown reduced, Ultimate damage increased

hero_adjustments.name: Agudo
hero_adjustments.details_raw:
Release and Blessing Mechanism: Recovery was replaced by Release, allowing Agudo to release monsters and receive one corresponding blessing at a time; Golems require Smite.
Mountain Encounter: Basic Attacks drop Seed Mines. Agudo could touch them to recover Health, gain stacking Attack Speed, and reduce Skill 2's cooldown, while enemies touching them took physical damage. Agudo received all equipment buffs and Furball inherited 50%.
Wild Growth: Planted a meadow that increased teammates' Movement and Attack Speed and restored Health. Agudo and her summoned creatures received double benefits, multiple companions were summoned, and Seed Mines were pulled toward Agudo.
Tumble, Furball!: In fused form, Agudo rolled forward and separated from Furball after colliding with an enemy hero. In human form, she rolled forward and enhanced her next Basic Attack to fire three Seed Mines.
Gorge Mobilization: Furball separated, leapt to the target, dealt physical damage, launched enemies, and fought independently with increased Attack Speed, Movement Speed, and a shield. Agudo recovered Health, cleared crowd control, and could recast to recall Furball.

hero_adjustments.name: Mayene
hero_adjustments.summary: Enhanced Synergy Between Different Skill Combos
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Mayene can combine skills to create a number of distinct effects. We've enhanced the synergies between these effects, opening up for new and creative combos.

hero_adjustments.name: Ziya
hero_adjustments.details_raw: We've added a new Sanctification effect for Ziya that will be available when playing as a roamer.

hero_adjustments.name: Cirrus
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Damage over time is an important element of how Cirrus deals damage. He has to lead with repeated hits. We've reduced his skill cooldowns to increase his overall damage frequency."

hero_adjustments.name: Dian Wei
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Dian Wei's skills allow him to clear enemy crowd control effects. We've reduced his own crowd control effects to give the enemy a chance to escape from his attack range."

hero_adjustments.name: Gao
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Attack Range and Added Damage Reduction to Ultimate
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Gao needs to get close to as many enemies as possible while using his Ultimate, so we've increased his damage reduction to improve his survivability. Additionally, we've increased his range so it's easier for him to find a way to enter combat."

hero_adjustments.name: Han Xin
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Han Xin's Skill 2 interrupting his Passive has been a huge pain point for players for a long time now. We've addressed the issue in this update. Additionally, we've enhanced his Passive's effects. Now, the Passive and Skill 2 work together to create a stronger combined effect."

hero_adjustments.name: Liu Shan
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "As a tank support, it's Liu Shan's job to take damage in the frontline, while also trying to crowd control enemies. We've reduced his skill cooldowns to improve his performance in both areas."

hero_adjustments.name: Ming
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Ming will often find himself standing in front of teammates drawing fire as he buffs them. As such, we've slightly increased the recovery he gets from his Passive to give him a bit more room to breathe in battle."

hero_adjustments.name: Pei
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Pei has to switch forms to maximize his skill effects, but while in his tiger form, he has much shorter range and needs to get very close to his enemies. We've increased the stats of his tiger form to give him a higher margin of error."

hero_adjustments.name: Sakeer
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Sakeer has performed exceptionally well since his release. We have moderately nerfed him to ensure a better experience for opponents."

hero_adjustments.name: Angela
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Skill 1: Scorching Barrage

skills_changed.change: Scorching Barrage

hero_adjustments.name: Di Renjie
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Changed the stat-based calculation of the tokens' damage, so Di Renjie is no longer limited to attack effect equipment, but can try out other   builds.

hero_adjustments.name: Erin
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Skill 1's damage and Physical Defense.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: During the 'I'm a dev for HoK!' event in Honor of Kings Camp, there were many calls to buff Erin, so we have increased her viability in the early game.

hero_adjustments.name: Guiguzi
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced cooldown and increased damage from his Passive.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: There were many calls to buff Guiguzi during the 'I'm a designer at HoK!' event in HoK Camp. Guiguzi players want to show off how good he can be, but don't always succeed. Hence, we have reduced some of his skill cooldowns to give them more opportunities to try.

hero_adjustments.name: Li Bai
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base stats and Ultimate damage.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Li Bai has an agile combat style. We have increased his stats to improve his survivability if he makes a mistake.

hero_adjustments.name: Mai Shiranui
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced Skill 2's cooldown and slightly decreased its damage.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: This allows Mai Shiranui to use her Skill 2 more frequently, while balancing its damage to prevent instant kills.

hero_adjustments.name: Ying
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced skill cooldowns and increased damage and Health recovery.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Ying was near the top in the rankings during the 'I'm a designer at HoK!' event in HoK Camp. Actually, Ying has notbeen updated for a while. We have reduced her skill cooldowns and slightly increased their damage and Health recovery.

hero_adjustments.name: Consort Yu
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Consort Yu's passive triggers on a chance. We wanted to give it more consistent damage output when it triggers.

hero_adjustments.name: Dian Wei
hero_adjustments.details_raw: The enhanced Basic Attack's dash prevented Dian Wei from fully utilizing his Attack Range advantage and would even put him in danger in some situations. Hence, we have improved this mechanic so the dash effect remains the same without a target.

hero_adjustments.name: Dun
hero_adjustments.details_raw: As a versatile fighter, Dun has excellent survivability. We have adjusted his skill bonuses to make him perform more consistently when using different equipment.

hero_adjustments.name: Gao Changgong
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Prince of Lanling's stealth ability puts pressure on the opponent, even if he's leaving or only passing through. We've improved the indicator so that opponents can gauge his distance based on the blinking speed, giving them room to focus on the crucial moment.

hero_adjustments.name: Kaizer
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Kaizer's damage absorption makes him a great frontline tank. We've increased his damage output so he can also work well with an attack preset.

hero_adjustments.name: Kongming
hero_adjustments.summary: Balanced the effects of different presets.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Previously, we tried reducing Skill 2's cooldown time. Multiple dashes made Kongming hard to counter if his team was winning, but Skill 2 would lack damage output if his team was at a disadvantage. Hence, we've changed the number of stocks Skill 1 and Skill 2 can hold to make Kongming more consistent in various situations and lanes.

hero_adjustments.name: Lu Bu
hero_adjustments.summary: Basic Attacks and skills deal true damage when enhanced and gain Physical Pierce when not enchanted.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: True damage is the highlight of Lu Bu's playstyle, but it's not always possible to enchant his weapon. Therefore, we have added a new mechanic so Lu Bu can deal more damage when unenchanted.

hero_adjustments.name: Luara
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Luara's passive made her overly reliant on Critical Rate equipment. We wanted to give her a playstyle that utilizes attack effects, so we adjusted the Critical Rate and attack effect aspects of her skillset. Also, since Luara gained serpent blades whenever she performs kills or assists, her performance was very dependent on the match situation. We hope that these changes will give her more consistency. Finally, we have also improved her playability and the display of some mechanics.

hero_adjustments.name: Luna
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Luna is typically forced to leave the battlefield if her Ultimate fails. We have changed Luna's Basic Attack to allow her to contribute ranged damage while looking for a chance to return to battle.

hero_adjustments.name: Nuwa
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "I decide your future!" Nuwa  gains the ability to jump across matrices, and her matrices can now converge and merge.”

hero_adjustments.name: Zilong
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Skill 2 is Zilong's main damage skill, but its damage output is somewhat lacking if it doesn't trigger his passive. Hence, we've slightly increased Skill 2's damage.

hero_adjustments.name: Lady Zhen
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Skill 2's bounces, reduced Skill 1 CD
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Lady Zhen's bounce attacks perform well during small team fights in the early to mid game. To better pace her power level and make it last until the late game, we've changed the number of bounces her Skill 2 has. We've also reduced the cooldown of her Skill 1 to give her more opportunities to freeze enemies and protect herself in the early game.

hero_adjustments.name: Liu Bei
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased BA range, reduced Skill 1 CD in early game
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Liu Bei's shotgun is most effective up close, and Skill 1 is his core damage and mobility skill, so we have reduced its cooldown in the early game to improve his leveling efficiency. The range of his shotgun has also been increased to give him some mid-range coverage.

hero_adjustments.name: Menki
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Menki can't speak, but we all know it wants to become even stronger.

hero_adjustments.name: Xiao Qiao
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Work hard and get stronger, Xiao Qiao.

hero_adjustments.name: Yaria
hero_adjustments.summary: Passive's CD reduces with level, adjusted shield multiplier
hero_adjustments.details_raw: In the mid to late game, most heroes' skills get shorter cooldowns and higher DPS. The cooldown of Yaria's passive feels quite long in comparison, so we've reduced its cooldown per hero level. The effect of Yaria's shield will now also vary based on the target.

hero_adjustments.name: Daji
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced skill cooldown and enhanced the range and casting mechanics of her Skill 1
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Daji is a mage that can deal impressive amounts of burst damage against single targets. However, whether she can obtain enough resources in the early game often determines her overall performance in the match. In order to help her along, we've shortened her skill cooldowns so that she can pull off more kills in the early game."

hero_adjustments.name: Diaochan
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Diaochan is one of only a few mages who have to get up close and personal with her enemies. This leaves her more vulnerable to attacks, so we've enhanced her base stats in order to help her shine."

hero_adjustments.name: Fuzi
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced the cooldown of Skills 1 and 2 in the late game
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Fuzi's passive ability to reduce the cooldown of his Skills 1 and 2 with his Basic Attack is an important part of his performance. However, in the late game team fights, he doesn't have much time left for Basic Attacks. As such, we've reduced the cooldown of his Skills 1 and 2 in the late game to increase his chances of survival."

hero_adjustments.name: Garo
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced Skill 1 damage, standardized Ultimate effects
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Garo's recent performance in the Farm Lane has been too good, as the range and early-game damage from her Skill 1 make it easy for her to gain an advantage during the laning stage. As such, we've reduced the skill's damage. At the same time, we've also standardized the effects of using and ending her Ultimate to make things easier to understand."

hero_adjustments.name: Musashi
hero_adjustments.summary: Balanced Stats to Suit Different Equipment
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "We've made adjustments to Musashi's skill stat bonuses to balance the effectiveness of various equipment builds."

hero_adjustments.name: Nezha
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Nezha often initiates team fights, which also means that he tends to draw the enemy's firepower. As such, we've enhanced his base stats so that he can survive until his teammates arrive to help."

hero_adjustments.name: Shouyue
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Previously, players using Shouyue had a hard time choosing between sniping from a distance and using Basic Attacks at a closer range. Now, we've upgraded his skills to give our players more equipment options. At the same time, with the same set of equipment, players can now mix long-range sniping with Basic Attacks more effectively."

hero_adjustments.name: Wuyan
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Currently, Wuyan's ability to hit the enemy with the center of her Skill 2 attack plays a huge part in her overall performance, so we've made adjustments to help her perform more consistently across different situations. At the same time, we've made adjustments to her skills' stat bonuses to give players more options in terms of her equipment."

hero_adjustments.name: Di Renjie
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base Movement Speed and the early game damage of Skill 1's tokens.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Magistrate Di has been lying low for a while, it's time for him to bring judgment to his opponents."

hero_adjustments.name: Zhou Yu
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base Movement Speed and Skill 1's late game cooldown.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Zhou Yu needs some preparation to fully ignite the battlefield. We've slightly increased his mobility to help him find the right positioning and angles. At the same time, we've slightly increased the late game cooldown of his Skill 1, giving opponents a fair chance to dodge it."

hero_adjustments.name: Fang
hero_adjustments.summary: Passive's extra damage now applies to minions
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "As he is a marksman, we want his passive to also apply to minions to increase his farming speed, rather than only being effective when he's jungling."

hero_adjustments.name: Lam
hero_adjustments.summary: Balanced early and late game strength, and made it harder to repeatedly use enhanced Basic Attacks
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "The mechanism that let Lam's enhanced Basic Attack reduce Skill 2's cooldown by a fixed amount allowed Lam to spam his Skill 2 and enhanced Basic Attack in the late game. This made it difficult for opponents to counter him, a situation that we hope to improve with these adjustments. At the same time, we have moderately increased the base effects of his skills to enhance the experience for newer players."

hero_adjustments.name: Lian Po
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased damage output of enhanced Basic Attack and Ultimate
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "While Lian Po already provides great crowd control, we also want him to pose a greater threat damage wise."

hero_adjustments.name: Sun Ce
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base stats and Ultimate damage
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "We hope that Sun Ce's Ultimate will not only serve as a way to assist teammates, but also provide some extra damage in his combos."

hero_adjustments.name: Arthur
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced Skill 1 cooldown, adjusted damage structure.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Arthur's mobility and the silence effect on his Skill 1 are crucial for his playstyle. The initial cooldown of this skill has been a bit too long, so we're reducing it to give Arthur more flexibility in skill upgrades."

hero_adjustments.name: Biron
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased shield and healing when using defensive equipment.

hero_adjustments.name: Kongming
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased damage from Skill 1 and reduced Skill 2 charge time.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Increasing Kongming's damage while reducing his dash skill's charge time to make him more flexible."

hero_adjustments.name: Liu Shan
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased shield from Skill 1 when using defensive equipment.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "We want Liu Shan's survivability to be more connected with his equipment choices."

hero_adjustments.name: Wukong
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced Ultimate cooldown and increased passive base damage.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Wukong has been underperforming lately. His enhanced Basic Attack, being his primary damage source, relies heavily on completing his equipment. We're increasing the Growth of his enhanced Basic Attack, so he can still pose a threat even when behind."

hero_adjustments.name: Augran
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced his ability to deal sustained damage with his Basic Attack.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Augran could consistently continue to deal damage in between attacks from his opponents. We're reducing his sustained damage output to prevent opponents from being taken down too early."

hero_adjustments.name: Charlotte
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced cooldown and made it easier to maintain passive stacks.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Charlotte's passive wears off over time, which wastes her previous efforts. We've made it easier for her to maintain her passive, hoping she can perform better."

hero_adjustments.name: Da Qiao
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased the area of Skill 1 and 3, and enhanced Skill 2.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "We strengthened Da Qiao's own growth to make it possible for her to appear in more positions."

hero_adjustments.name: Diaochan
hero_adjustments.summary: Made cooldown reduction for Skill 2 smoother.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Diaochan's Skill 2 provides a significant cooldown reduction when hitting enemies, but it can be very frustrating when a miss disrupts follow-up combos.  In order to alleviate this, we've made the cooldown reduction mechanism more continuous."

hero_adjustments.name: Dolia
hero_adjustments.summary: Removed Skill 1's knockback effect on distant enemies.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Dolia's Skill 1 already damages and slows enemies in a wide area. By removing the knockback effect for distant targets, we aim to reduce her ability to poke and interrupt enemies."

hero_adjustments.name: Gan & Mo
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Gan & Mo can deal extremely high damage after activating their Ultimate, but if they miss, they'll be more or less harmless for a short period of time. To alleviate this, we're giving them more chances to deal damage, and allowing them to more freely choose a comfortable attack range."

hero_adjustments.name: Garo
hero_adjustments.summary: Casting speed of Skill 2 increases with Attack Speed.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "A fixed casting time made it increasingly dangerous for Garo to use this skill in the late game. Now, her Skill 2's casting speed increases with her Attack Speed."

hero_adjustments.name: Han Xin
hero_adjustments.summary: Improved base Physical Defense and balanced Ultimate's late game damage

hero_adjustments.name: Mai Shiranui
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced Energy Cost for Skill 2 and the Ultimate.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Currently, even when Mai Shiranui has full Energy, missing with a skill can prevent her from completing her full skill combos. We slightly reduced Energy Cost to alleviate this issue."

hero_adjustments.name: Menki
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "We're making Menki's stats match up better with his Mass."

hero_adjustments.name: Ukyo Tachibana
hero_adjustments.summary: Improved the and healing and prgression of his passive, and upgraded the second stage of Skill 1.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "The fixed cooldown of his passive limited Ukyo Tachibana's late game damage output, so we have adjusted its scaling to allow it to interact better with his skills. At the same time, we have lowered the unlock conditions for the second stage of his Skill 1, improving his flexibility to some extent."

hero_adjustments.name: Yao
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base Physical Defense and reduced the cooldown of Skill 2.

hero_adjustments.name: Allain
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Basic Attack interval and reduced Ultimate's shield effect.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Allain's continuous Basic Attack and counterattack capabilities with his Ultimate have made him a strong contender in both the Clash Lane and team fights. We are slightly nerfing him to allow other heroes to better compete against him.

hero_adjustments.name: Arli
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Arli's flexibility is her trademark, so we are reducing her early game cooldown to let her better showcase her strengths.

hero_adjustments.name: Erin
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Erin can explore both physical and magic equipment. We're improving her base stats to ensure she remains strong under different playstyles.

hero_adjustments.name: Huang Zhong
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Huang Zhong is still full of vigor, and we hope this change will make him more flexible in combat.

hero_adjustments.name: Lady Zhen
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced mid to late game damage and lowered the slow effect of Ultimate during the early and mid game.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Lady Zhen has strong area crowd control and continuous poking capabilities. Her Skill 1 also enhances survivability. We are slightly reducing her damage output and crowd control to allow other heroes to better compete against her.

hero_adjustments.name: Liu Bei
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Do no evil no matter how small, and do not avoid doing good no matter how small.

hero_adjustments.name: Luban No.7
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Luban No.7 has been outperforming other marksmen for a long time, so it's time to tone him down a bit.

hero_adjustments.name: Yang Jian
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced cooldown for Skill 1 and Ultimate, and increased Ultimate's healing.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Yang Jian often needs to dash into the enemy crowd. We've increased his Ultimate's recovery amount and frequency to help him sustain longer in combat.

hero_adjustments.name: Angela
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Ultimate's cooldown in the early and mid game.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Angela has powerful burst damage, and her skill cooldowns are relatively short, allowing her to use skill combos to frequently obliterate opponents. We've increased the cooldown time of her Ultimate in the early and mid game to slightly slow down her pace during these stages."

hero_adjustments.name: Butterfly
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased the duration of Ultimate's Mark.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "The Mark from Butterfly's Ultimate is a crucial mechanic. We've increased the duration of the Mark to give her more room for error and better leverage this feature."

hero_adjustments.name: Dharma
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Currently, Dharma is relatively weak, so we've reduced the cooldown of his Ultimate to give him more opportunities to knock opponents into walls. Since his Skill 2's stationary punch is difficult to land on agile opponents, we've shortened the stock time for his Skill 1, allowing him to better adjust the position of his Skill 2."

hero_adjustments.name: Garo
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced the extra damage ratio to shields.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Garo's passive gives her a significant advantage when facing opponents with shields. We've reduced this advantage to balance her strength against different opponents while also improving the experience for shielded heroes when facing Garo."

hero_adjustments.name: Heino
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced the continuous poke of Skill 1 and reduced the damage reduction when Ultimate is used.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Currently, Heino offers a poor counterplay experience for opponents. His Ultimate's high damage reduction and restoration allow him to continuously poke enemies while being difficult to counter. We've reduced his damage output and the room for error in his Ultimate, giving opponents more opportunities to counter him."

hero_adjustments.name: Kaizer
hero_adjustments.summary: Balanced the strength of different builds.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Currently, Kaizer's overall strength is too high, especially when he purchases a lot of defensive equipment, making it difficult for opponents to counter him. Therefore, we've slightly reduced his strength when using defensive builds while maintaining his power with offensive builds."

hero_adjustments.name: Lu Bu
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "We've increased the damage of Lu Bu's Skill 2 to prevent opponents from escaping with low Health. His restoration and shield capabilities benefit much more from high-attack builds compared to survival-focused builds, so we've made adjustments accordingly."

hero_adjustments.name: Ming
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced the early game bonus to teammates.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "In the early game, Ming can boost his team's effectiveness when linking with allies, creating a whole that is greater than its parts and further magnifying any advantage gained. In order to alleviate this, we've slightly reduced the early game bonus he provides to allies."

hero_adjustments.name: Zhou Yu
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Skill 2's damage over time and recovery and reduced late game stock time.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: "Zhou Yu's Skill 2 provides damage over time and recovery. We aim to strengthen this playstyle appropriately while adjusting the cooldown between early and late game to balance his power throughout the match."

hero_adjustments.name: Augran
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Ultimate cooldown and reduced damage and recovery of Skill 2

hero_adjustments.name: Han Xin
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base Health and Skill 1 damage, reduced Skill 1's early game CD.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Han Xin needs an economic advantage to be useful in team fights. We've adjusted his Skill 1 so that he can participate in team fights earlier, and we've boosted his Health to give him a wider margin of error in those team fights

hero_adjustments.name: Li Bai
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Increasing Skill 1's damage allows Li Bai to deal good damage before he gets his Ultimate

hero_adjustments.name: Li Xin
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased Movement Speed and early game base stats, reduced mobility in Revenge form.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Li Xin is rather weak right now, but his Revenge form is very hard to counter. We've boosted his stats in both his forms, especially in the early game, but we've reduced his mobility in Revenge form to make it easier for opponents to chase him down

hero_adjustments.name: Luban No.7
hero_adjustments.summary: Adjusted Passive effect's damage against different targets.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Luban's Passive works the same regardless of the target's Health, so heroes cannot guard against it by increasing their Health. As such, we've reduced his effectiveness against high-Health targets. As compensation, we've increased his ability to threaten the enemy carry

hero_adjustments.name: Mulan
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased damage reduction while wielding the heavy sword and the damage of Skill 1 when wielding both heavy and dual swords.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: We made Mulan tankier while wielding her heavy sword and increased her overall damage output. Hopefully she will now perform better in team fights

hero_adjustments.name: Yuhuan
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased number of Skill 1 sound waves, base damage, and jungling effectiveness
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Her smile could melt your heart. The powdered faces of all the ladies-in-waiting paled in comparison

hero_adjustments.name: Dian Wei
hero_adjustments.summary: Added a dash to his Skill 1 and reduced the extra true damage from his Ultimate
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Dian Wei's high Attack Speed and recovery allow him to fight for sustained periods of time. However, without a dash, it's difficult for him to chase and approach enemies who have movement skills. That's why we decided to add a dash to his enhanced Basic Attack while making a minor adjustment to the extra true damage dealt by his Ultimate.

hero_adjustments.name: Hou Yi
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Hou Yi's stable Basic Attack and ability to target multiple enemies at once make it hard for other marksmen to compete with him, so we've lowered the frequency of his Basic Attacks slightly to give his enemies time to catch their breath.

hero_adjustments.name: Shangguan
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base Movement Speed and reduced Skill 2's stock interval.

hero_adjustments.name: Wang Zhaojun
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced early game strength while allowing her to use Skill 2 more frequently in the late game

hero_adjustments.name: Yao
hero_adjustments.summary: Increased base stats and Skill 1 damage
hero_adjustments.details_raw: While Yao's combat style relies on him being able to freely move in and out of battle, his current stats don't really enable him to do this well. So, we increased them to allow him greater freedom to enter and exit fights.

hero_adjustments.name: Zhang Fei
hero_adjustments.summary: Added a launch effect to his Skill 1 and Skill 2 while he is transformed by his Ultimate.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: We wanted to make his skills better match his massive body

hero_adjustments.name: Zhuangzi
hero_adjustments.summary: Reduced his Ultimate's cooldown and buffed his shield
hero_adjustments.details_raw: The interval between each use of Zhuangzi's Ultimate is too long. Also, his shield is often overlooked by his teammates. By buffing the shield, we've made Zhuangzi useful even if he is unable to cleanse teammates of crowd controls.

hero_adjustments.name: Lady Zhen
hero_adjustments.summary: Slightly improved laning in the early game, but weakened poking in the late game.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Lady Zhen is a mage with exceptional damage and crowd control. In the current version of the game, she is clearly a bit too powerful. We hope to reduce Lady Zhen's domination in the mid to late game and, while lowering her damage and poke ability in the late game, adequately supplement her lane clearing in the early game.

hero_adjustments.name: Marco Polo
hero_adjustments.summary: Smoothed Attack Speed gains, improving growth.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Marco Polo's current Attack Speed benefits don't pay off much until the late game, so we gave the Attack Speed boost of his Skill 1 and Ultimate more specific tiering to ensure that early-game Attack Speed boosts provide a corresponding reward.

hero_adjustments.name: Wukong
hero_adjustments.summary: Ultimate damage and Skill 1 shield are increased, improving play from the beginning.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: Wukong is currently too weak, so we strengthened the shield of his Skill 1, giving him a stronger response when successfully blocking skills. Since his Ultimate is an important part of his skill combos, we also hope to adequately improve his early-game stats to ensure his playability from the start.

hero_adjustments.name: Zilong
hero_adjustments.summary: The cooldown is returned if no heroes are hit by his Ultimate.
hero_adjustments.details_raw: When Zilong's Ultimate fails to hit the enemy, he struggles to put pressure on them, so we want to improve his cooldown mechanics to give him more opportunities to engage in team fights. We also improved his late-game cooldowns, giving the opponent time to counterattack after being hit by an Ultimate.
